claims: Viral claims about $490 Gucci diapers are a manufactured rumor or misinformation originating from social media content creators.
Viral claims about $490 Gucci diapers are not a real product launch.
Gucci does not sell branded diapers.
Posts circulated claiming a pack of Gucci diapers cost around $490.
There is no official product listing from Gucci for diapers.
Gucci does sell Designer Diaper Bags and Totes in their official Baby Collection.
Gucci's Designer Diaper Bags and Totes are legitimate items.
Gucci's Designer Diaper Bags and Totes often feature the GG monogram
